subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in
stimulus: the parentheses. 1×5=5 Students are the future (a) ______ (lead) and (b) ______ (make) of the nation. They should train themselves in performing the duties and responsibilities to be imposed on them by their nation from the (c) ______ (education) institutions. In order to do something great (d) __________ (selfless) for the society in later life, the students while studying should render some social services. It will help them to remove self-centredness, (e) __________ (narrow) bigotry and widen their outlook in life.
